Title: Select robust indicators based on missingness

<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read the input data
input_data = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Calculate missingness for each indicator
missingness = input_data.isnull().sum(axis=0).reset_index()
missingness.columns = ['indicator', 'missing_count']

# Calculate missing rate for each indicator
missingness['missing_rate'] = missingness['missing_count'] / input_data.shape[0]

# Determine which indicators to keep
missingness['kept'] = missingness['missing_rate'] <= 0.30

# Write the missingness report to CSV
missingness[['indicator', 'missing_count', 'missing_rate', 'kept']].to_csv(
    'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False, quotechar='"')

# Select the indicators to keep and write the selected matrix to CSV
selected_data = input_data[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]
for indicator in missingness['indicator'][missingness['kept']]:
    selected_data[indicator] = input_data[indicator].fillna(0)

selected_data.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False, quotechar='"')
</solution_file>
